name: player_zar_read_mission_save_data_section
description: Player::ZAR_ReadMissionSaveDataSection applies mission-save data, restores the saved camera variant tag, refreshes HUD/layout state, and restores recorded node flags.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player mission-save/ZAR source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41f640 validates the callback tail argument as PlayerMissionSaveData*, calling Player::ApplyMissionSaveData, copying lastValidCameraVariantTag into g_Player_LastValidCameraVariantTag, optionally invoking zEffect_Anim::NodeActionCallback for inactive local-player destroyed-respawn effects, refreshing HUD from g_GameStateOrMapTable, triggering the current HUD layout activation, and restoring recorded node flags.

The native smoke verifies the callback applies the mission-save payload through the active controller path, restores g_Player_LastValidCameraVariantTag from the save payload, refreshes shield and nanite HUD state, and invokes RestoreRecordedNodeFlags.
